description: An O-Level study of Swahili phonology covering speech sounds (vowels and consonants), syllable structure, stress, spelling, and phonological processes.

mcq.questionText: Fonolojia ni tawi la isimu linaloshughulikia nini?

options.text: Sauti za lugha na mfumo wake

mcq.explanation: Phonology (fonolojia) is the branch of linguistics that studies the speech sounds of a language and how they are organised into a system.

mcq.questionText: Lugha ya Kiswahili sanifu ina irabu (vokali) ngapi?
mcq.explanation: Standard Swahili has five vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

mcq.questionText: Ni mfululizo upi unaoonyesha irabu zote za Kiswahili?
mcq.explanation: The complete set of Swahili vowels is a, e, i, o, u.
The word 'baba' splits into two syllables: ba-ba.

mcq.questionText: Katika Kiswahili, silabi za kawaida huishia na nini?
mcq.explanation: Swahili has an open-syllable structure; ordinary syllables end in a vowel (irabu).

mcq.questionText: Neno 'shule' limegawanyika katika silabi vipi kwa usahihi?
mcq.explanation: 'shule' is divided as shu-le; 'sh' is a single sound and each syllable ends in a vowel.

mcq.questionText: Kwa kawaida shadda (mkazo) katika maneno ya Kiswahili huwekwa wapi?
mcq.explanation: In Swahili, stress normally falls on the penultimate (second-to-last) syllable.

mcq.questionText: Katika neno 'kitabu', shadda huwa kwenye silabi ipi?
mcq.explanation: 'kitabu' = ki-ta-bu; the penultimate syllable 'ta' carries the stress.

mcq.questionText: Sauti ipi kati ya zifuatazo ni konsonanti?
mcq.explanation: The sound 'm' is a consonant; a, e and u are vowels.
The sound 'ng'' is a velar nasal consonant, as heard at the start of 'ng'ombe'.

options.text: Uandishi sahihi wa maneno kwa kufuata sauti na herufi

mcq.explanation: Tahajia (spelling/orthography) is the correct writing of words following the relationship between sounds and letters.

mcq.questionText: Sauti zipi huitwa viyeyusho (nusu-irabu) katika Kiswahili?
mcq.explanation: The semivowels (viyeyusho) of Swahili are 'w' and 'y'.

mcq.questionText: Katika tangamano la irabu (vowel harmony), kiambishi tendea cha neno 'soma' ni kipi?
mcq.explanation: Through vowel harmony, a root with 'o/a' takes the '-ea' applicative form: soma > somea.

mcq.questionText: Neno lipi limegawanywa katika silabi kwa usahihi?
mcq.explanation: In 'mtoto' the nasal 'm' forms its own syllable: m-to-to.

mcq.questionText: Mabadiliko ya kifonolojia ambapo sauti hudondoshwa (kuondolewa) huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Udondoshaji is the phonological process of deleting (dropping) a sound.

fib.questionText: Tawi la isimu linalochunguza sauti za lugha huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Phonology (fonolojia) studies the sound system of a language.

fib.questionText: Irabu za Kiswahili ni a, e, i, o na _____.
fib.explanation: The five Swahili vowels are a, e, i, o, u.

fib.questionText: Katika Kiswahili, silabi ya kawaida huishia na _____.
fib.explanation: Swahili syllables are open and end in a vowel (irabu).

fib.questionText: Mkazo unaowekwa kwenye silabi wakati wa kutamka huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Shadda is the stress placed on a syllable when speaking.

fib.questionText: Kwa kawaida shadda katika Kiswahili huwa kwenye silabi ya _____ kutoka mwisho.
fib.explanation: Stress normally falls on the second (penultimate) syllable from the end.

fib.questionText: Sauti 'w' na 'y' huitwa _____ kwa sababu zina sifa za irabu na konsonanti.
fib.explanation: 'w' and 'y' are semivowels (viyeyusho), sharing vowel and consonant features.

fib.questionText: Uandishi sahihi wa maneno kwa kufuata uhusiano wa sauti na herufi huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Correct spelling following sound-letter relationships is tahajia.

fib.questionText: Mchakato wa kuondoa au kudondosha sauti katika neno huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Udondoshaji is the deletion or dropping of a sound.

fib.questionText: Neno 'kalamu' likigawanywa katika silabi linakuwa ka-la-_____.
fib.explanation: 'kalamu' divides into ka-la-mu, ending with the syllable 'mu'.

tf.questionText: Fonolojia inashughulikia sauti za lugha na jinsi zinavyopangwa.
tf.explanation: True. Phonology deals with speech sounds and their organisation in a language.
False. Standard Swahili has only five vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

tf.questionText: Silabi za kawaida za Kiswahili huishia na irabu.
tf.explanation: True. Swahili has an open-syllable structure ending in vowels.

tf.questionText: Shadda katika Kiswahili kwa kawaida huwa kwenye silabi ya kwanza ya neno.
tf.explanation: False. Stress normally falls on the penultimate (second-to-last) syllable, not the first.
False. These five sounds are vowels (irabu), not consonants.
False. 'mwalimu' = mwa-li-mu, which is three syllables, not four.

tf.questionText: Tahajia inahusu uandishi sahihi wa maneno kwa kuzingatia sauti na herufi.
tf.explanation: True. Tahajia is correct spelling based on the relationship between sounds and letters.

tf.questionText: Tangamano la irabu hufanya neno 'soma' kuwa 'somea' katika kauli ya kutendea.
tf.explanation: True. Vowel harmony produces the applicative 'somea' from the root 'soma'.

tf.questionText: Sauti 'w' na 'y' huitwa viyeyusho au nusu-irabu.
Katika neno 'mtu', sauti 'm' inaweza kuwa silabi yake yenyewe.
tf.explanation: True. The syllabic nasal 'm' can form a syllable on its own, as in m-tu.

summary.questionText: Eleza kwa ufupi maana ya fonolojia.
summary.correctAnswer: Fonolojia ni tawi la isimu linalochunguza sauti za lugha na jinsi zinavyofanya kazi na kupangwa katika lugha husika.
summary.explanation: Phonology is the branch of linguistics that studies a language's sounds and how they function and are organised.

summary.correctAnswer: Irabu tano za Kiswahili ni a, e, i, o na u.
summary.explanation: Swahili has five vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya irabu na konsonanti.
summary.correctAnswer: Irabu hutamkwa bila kizuizi cha hewa mdomoni, ilhali konsonanti hutamkwa kwa kuzuia au kupunguza mkondo wa hewa.
summary.explanation: Vowels are produced with an open vocal tract (no obstruction), while consonants involve obstruction or restriction of airflow.

summary.questionText: Eleza muundo wa silabi katika Kiswahili.
summary.correctAnswer: Silabi za Kiswahili kwa kawaida huundwa na konsonanti pamoja na irabu na huishia na irabu, ingawa nazali kama 'm' na 'n' zinaweza kuwa silabi pekee.
summary.explanation: Swahili syllables are typically consonant-plus-vowel and end in a vowel (open syllables), though nasals like m/n can be syllabic on their own.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya shadda na pale inapowekwa kwa kawaida.
summary.correctAnswer: Shadda ni mkazo wa sauti unaowekwa kwenye silabi wakati wa kutamka, na kwa kawaida huwa kwenye silabi ya pili kutoka mwisho.
summary.explanation: Shadda is the stress placed on a syllable; it normally falls on the penultimate syllable.
'walimu' divides into three open syllables: wa-li-mu.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya tahajia na umuhimu wake.
summary.correctAnswer: Tahajia ni uandishi sahihi wa maneno kwa kufuata uhusiano kati ya sauti na herufi, na ni muhimu kwa mawasiliano sahihi ya maandishi.
summary.explanation: Tahajia is correct spelling based on sound-letter relationships; it is important for accurate written communication.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya tangamano la irabu kwa mfano.
summary.correctAnswer: Tangamano la irabu ni kupatana kwa irabu za viambishi na irabu ya mzizi, kwa mfano 'soma' huwa 'somea' na 'cheza' huwa 'cheza/chezea'.
summary.explanation: Vowel harmony is the agreement between affix vowels and the root vowel, e.g. the applicative of 'soma' is 'somea'.

summary.questionText: Taja mabadiliko mawili ya kifonolojia na ueleze kwa kifupi.
summary.correctAnswer: Mabadiliko mawili ni udondoshaji (kuondoa sauti) na uyeyushaji (kubadilisha irabu kuwa kiyeyusho), kwa mfano u+a kuwa wa.
summary.explanation: Two processes are deletion (udondoshaji) and gliding/semivowel formation (uyeyushaji), e.g. u+a becoming 'wa'.

summary.questionText: Eleza dhima ya viyeyusho katika Kiswahili.
summary.correctAnswer: Viyeyusho 'w' na 'y' ni nusu-irabu zinazotokea kati ya irabu au mwanzoni mwa silabi, kwa mfano 'wewe' na 'yeye'.
summary.explanation: The semivowels 'w' and 'y' occur between vowels or at syllable onsets, as in 'wewe' and 'yeye'.

hoq.questionText: Katika neno 'kuandika', mchakato wa uyeyushaji unaweza kutokea wapi unapotamkwa haraka?

options.text: Irabu 'u' kabla ya 'a' hubadilika kuwa kiyeyusho 'w' (kwandika)

hoq.explanation: In rapid speech the vowel 'u' before another vowel can become the glide 'w' (uyeyushaji), turning ku-a into kwa.

hoq.questionText: Mwanafunzi ameandika 'shuule' badala ya 'shule'. Kosa hili ni la aina gani la kifonolojia/tahajia?

options.text: Urudufishaji usio sahihi wa irabu (kurefusha irabu)

hoq.explanation: Writing 'shuule' wrongly doubles/lengthens the vowel 'u'; the correct spelling has a single vowel in 'shule'.

hoq.questionText: Neno 'kupokea' linaonyesha tangamano la irabu vipi katika kiambishi cha kutendea?

options.text: Mzizi 'pok-' wenye irabu 'o' huchukua kiambishi '-ea' badala ya '-ia'
Mzizi huchukua '-ia' kwa sababu ya irabu 'o'

hoq.explanation: Because the root vowel is 'o', vowel harmony selects the applicative suffix '-ea' (pok+ea > pokea), not '-ia'.
